items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network. Week 5 was at Tennessee. No score is printed here because Sunday has not been played.

items.hed: Astros are out; Cleveland leads Tampa Bay in the American League Championship Series
items.insight: MLB.com's postseason schedule lists the Dodgers, Brewers, Rays, and Guardians in the League Championship Series. Cleveland beat Tampa Bay 7-3 on Monday and leads the series 1-0. Game 2 is Tuesday night in Tampa Bay at 8 p.m. Eastern. Houston is not on that list.

items.hed: Rockets open at home against Dallas on Oct. 21
items.insight: The Rockets' schedule note says opening night, presented by Toyota, is against Dallas on Oct. 21 at Toyota Center. The same note says standard home tip times moved from 7 p.m. to 7:30 p.m., and it does not print a tip for that night, so none is stated here. Houston closed the preseason at home against Oklahoma City on Oct. 15.
